## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The feed filter stops treating a logged interaction as a finished to-do

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T11:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** the platform's own Log a Call / Log a Meeting writes a row that the platform's own default record page never shows, and `send_email`'s row is hidden the same way. It hits every object without an authored page, in a core CRM flow.
- **Direction, the card's second option:**
  - The `record:activity` / `record:discussion` feed filter tells a logged interaction (call, meeting, email) apart from a finished task, using the row's own fields. `showCompleted` then governs finished tasks only.
  - This covers authored pages too, like objectstack-ai/objectui#12106 did for milestones.
  - ⛔ The synthesizer's `showCompleted` default is not flipped: that would also surface every finished to-do on every default page.
  - The dev first reads which field marks a logged interaction on the rows the three actions write.
  - Pins:
    - a logged call shows on a default record page;
    - a finished task stays hidden while `showCompleted` is false;
    - an authored page with `showCompleted: true` is unchanged.
- **Delivery:** reaches hosted HotCRM with cloud's v18 framework move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709).
- Triage: lands in the record feed's filter (`domain:ui`); rationale: one filter rule.

Claim: PM loop round 2 (as triage `6123741436` directs: the feed filter tells a logged interaction (call, meeting, email) apart from a finished task by the row's own fields, so `showCompleted` governs finished tasks only; ⛔ the synthesizer's `showCompleted` default is not flipped)
Session: `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12228`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface, on objectui `main` `fc1bc666`:
- **The filter:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`, `applyFeedConfig` and its type map, where `completed` maps to kind `task` and kind `task` drops unless `showCompleted`. objectui#12106 fixed the milestone half in this same file.
- **Its readers,** read and not restructured: `record-activity.tsx` and `record-chatter.tsx` (both call `applyFeedConfig`).
- Co-located tests, and `.changeset/12228-logged-interaction-feed.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail` `patch`). Plus `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` only where it states what `showCompleted` hides.
- ⛔ No change to the default record page synthesizer's props, and no new spec key.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui's record feed filter (@object-ui/plugin-detail recordActivityFeed applyFeedConfig), which maps a completed sys_activity row to kind task and drops it unless showCompleted, so a logged call, meeting or email reads as a finished to-do | objectui#12106 already exempted milestone rows by their own field, and the platform's own Log a Call / Log a Meeting / send_email actions write these rows | every user who logs a call or meeting, or sends an email, on an object without an authored record page (measured on HotCRM crm_contact with @objectstack 17.7.0: log_call 200, row type completed, 0 matches in the page's feed)`
Thread-read: 6123741436
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T12:19Z on objectui `main` `fc1bc666`:
- **The filter file:** its last changes on `main` have landed (see the dev's `git log`). No open PR touches `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/`.
- **Neighbours:** none of this seat's in-flight cards (objectui#12198 `AppHeader`/`PageView` tests, objectui#12234 `FlowRunner`, objectui#12239 in the merge queue) touches `plugin-detail`. Seat 1's in-flight claims name no feed file.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12259 (head `62826ed`) · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd` · 2026-10-12T14:07Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report. Inputs: claim `6124142339` and report `6125699855`.

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #12228`, and no other closing keyword is in the body.
  - `Clause-②: no`.
  - `check-governed-merges --pr` reads NOT governed: 0 of 6 paths, 402 changed lines.
- **File surface:** one file is outside the claim, and the seat accepts it here.
  - `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` gains one sentence on the registry's `showCompleted` input description. Without it, that text would read false after this change. It is the same sentence the claim already named for `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`.
  - `record-chatter.tsx` (claimed as read, not restructured) gets a comment-only correction of the same sentence.
- **The fix:** read against the diff.
  - `applyFeedConfig`'s `showCompleted` filter keeps a `task` item that carries the ADR-0052 source pointer (`sourceObject` with a `sourceId`), through a module-private `isLoggedInteraction`.
  - These are the items the timeline already links with **View source**. They stay `task` items, so `types: ['task']` and `filterMode: 'tasks_only'` still select them.
  - A `completed` row without a pointer (a finished task) stays hidden by default.
  - The synthesizer is untouched, and `showCompleted`'s default stays `false`.
  - The field was read off the producers: HotCRM's `log_call`, `log_meeting` and `send_email` write the pointer. Neither of the two options the triage named as not wanted was taken: no `metadata.kind` name list, no remap off `task`.
- **Contract review: none owed.** No export, prop, type or accepted value set moves; `isLoggedInteraction` is not exported. The changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-detail` `patch`) was read sentence by sentence. It names the one sentence of the pending objectui#12106 entry that this narrows.
- **Evidence:** the dev ran the package suite (261 files, 2530 tests). Ablations:
  - with the exemption removed, the default-page and self-fetch DOM pins go red;
  - a half pointer (`sourceObject` alone) turns the two `source_id`-missing controls red;
  - exempting every task turns 16 cases red, objectui#12106's two unmarked-row pins among them.
- **CI** on `62826ed` reads 30 success and 3 skipped.
- **Out-of-scope findings**, one line each:
  - HotCRM's account, case and lead pages set `showCompleted: true`, which logged interactions no longer need, and the lead page's comment table is stale since objectui#5840: Acceptance notes. This is HotCRM's own text; `carrier:` the HotCRM seat. This seat does not write hotcrm.
  - The pending `.changeset/12106-milestone-kind-reader.md` sentence: carried by this PR's changeset, which names it.
- **Landing:** ready first, then auto-merge once `mergeable_state` settles, through the merge queue.
